name: mom
title: Mom
what: Teaches your agent to clean up after itself.
more: Before it says it's done, it stops what it started, bins its own temp files and puts reports where they belong. It loads by itself; you don't have to ask.

name: tidy-folders
title: Tidy folders
what: Puts loose papers, old installers and stray games where they belong.
more: It looks first, shows one page of what it found, and moves only what you tick. Every move is logged and can be undone.
prompts: Are all my games in the Games folder?

name: desktop-icons
title: Desktop icons
what: Clears dead shortcuts, duplicates and loose files off your desktop.
more: It reads shortcuts without ever running one. Shortcuts go to the Recycle Bin, files move into folders, and there's an undo.
prompts: Which of my desktop shortcuts are broken?

name: rename-documents
title: Rename documents
what: Gives scans and downloads names you can find later.
more: scan0001.pdf becomes 2024-03-14 Lanternfall invoice 1182.pdf. You see old and new side by side and tick the ones you want; there's an undo.
prompts: Rename my scans so I can find them
Give the PDFs in Downloads proper names

name: disk-space-report
title: Disk space report
what: Shows where your disk space went and the safe way to get it back.
more: A page with what fills each drive and what each part is. It deletes nothing itself.
prompts: Where did my disk space go?

name: backup-checkup
title: Backup checkup
what: Tells you what you'd lose if this disk died today.
more: Which folders and code have a second copy somewhere, and which don't. It only looks.
prompts: What would I lose if this disk died?

name: inbox-cleanup
title: Inbox cleanup
what: Reviews two months of Gmail and shows what to unsubscribe from.
more: Who fills your inbox, what you never open, likely phishing, and a plan to declutter. It reads only; nothing is deleted or sent.

name: calendar-fixer
title: Calendar fixer
what: Finds double bookings, days with no breaks and stale recurring meetings.
more: It reviews the next four weeks of Google Calendar and fixes only what you tick.

name: drive-audit
title: Drive audit
what: Shows what you share with anyone on Google Drive, and what fills it.
more: Public links, the biggest files, duplicates, and files nobody touched in a year. It only looks.

name: subscription-audit
title: Subscription audit
what: Finds what you pay for every month and what it costs a year.
more: From Gmail receipts and bank statements you export: price rises, things paid twice, trials about to charge. It never cancels or pays; you do the cancelling.
prompts: Which free trials are about to charge me?

name: bookmark-cleanup
title: Bookmark cleanup
what: Finds duplicate, dead and never-opened bookmarks.
more: It reads a copy of your bookmarks and writes a tidy file for you to import. Your browser's own files are never touched.
prompts: Which of my bookmarks are dead?
